messages.text:
Replogle Globes was founded in Chicago in 1930, and the brand has built its reputation there as the world's largest globe manufacturer. As an authorized Canadian retailer, we ship these genuine Replogle globes across Canada with the manufacturer's quality backing. You can read more in [The History and Craftsmanship Behind Replogle Globes](https://replogleglobes.ca/blogs/the-globe-guide/history-craftsmanship-replogle-globes).

Since you've been looking at desktop globes, are you choosing one for your own desk or as a gift for someone?
